geometry.literal_parent_body: Frozen v4: 122 HBT, 81 resistors, 6 MIM, 1 PMOS, 108 ptaps, 1 ntap; all conductive/device layers retained by native zero-XOR. Added 16 bondpads and 32 ESD devices.

substrate_contract.original_finite_taps: 108 physical SUB→ESD_RETURN contacts aggregate to A432p/P864u; one finite AVDD2V3→NWELL contact remains A4p/P8u.

preserved_failure.cause: Initial checker import named reference collided with a later local variable before any native deck ran. Changed only the import alias to physical_reference; old checker and exact error/log/command are retained. No geometry, device, deck or threshold changed.

render.scope: Actual native KLayout-rendered GDS, no illustration.

limitations: Isolated padded clocked macro connectivity/main-rule screen only; not main-chip integration, ESD stress/safe operating bias, RF, PEX, EM, or manufacturing approval.
ESD_RETURN intentionally exposes the actual shared substrate. Native ESD cells introduce additional body paths; this is neither independent ground isolation nor unchanged finite body impedance.
1.8 V, 2.5 V, 2.3 V and ESD supplies remain separate physical nets. External safe ESD_VDD/ESD_RETURN biases have not been transistor-level characterized here.
No extracted loading, post-layout 8 GHz, fanout/skew/jitter, clock/data phase alignment, PLL/CDR, complete SERDES or PCIe compliance claim.
Frozen component characterization and their existing limited margins remain applicable; geometric copying does not extend operating qualification.
external_material: No vendor source/runtime/model implementation included. Generated native GDS/reports, source/runtime/PDK/deck hashes and exact commands are retained.
reproduction: Pinned PDKc4b8b4e5, Librelane3.0.5 AppImage SHAd6a349ec65be11456e96c4981d35f63ca34d3c85daf79a51e1ccb907bb5d7466, unchanged DRC/LVS5e6d592.

AppImage python hw/soc/flow/make_pcie_padded_clocked_bank.py --pdk <PDK>/ihp-sg13g2 --bank <exact v4 layout> --bank-check <exact v4 checks> --pad <exact pad layout> --pad-check <exact pad checks> --out /dev/shm/nssoc-padded-clocked-<fresh-layout>
Each native child RLIMIT_AS2147483648 bytes; no elapsed watchdog claimed. Capsule has every final native output plus actual preflight failure; no output selection/downsampling.
